Hi Luke — great call earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can kick off the SIG/CAIQ path smoothly: 

- Goal: get a SIG/CAIQ or equivalent prefilling started, then hand off to our security team for evidence collection.
- Proposed timeline: we can prefill the questionnaire on our side within ~5 business days once we have answers to the items below; Security evidence handoff call after prefill.

Clarifying questions for BrightShore: 
1) SOC 2 status: is BrightShore currently SOC 2 Type II in production, or is Type II in progress? If in progress, expected completion month?
2) Data scope: will Redwood handle PHI/medical data for the pilot, or only financial PII? Any HIPAA applicability?
3) Deployment preference: are you aiming for our hosted API or a Private (VPC) deployment for the initial integration?
4) Primary security contact and preferred evidence exchange method (email vs SFTP vs shared Drive)?
5) If you already have a completed CAIQ or SIG starter, please attach; otherwise we can send a prefill template.

I've attached a quick intake template (redwood_sig_intake_template.xlsx) to speed the prefill. Once I have the answers and the security contact, I'll prefill the SIG and loop our security lead for evidence next steps.

Next steps from our side: I'll prefill the questionnaire and propose a 30–45 minute evidence-handoff call next week.

Thanks —

4) Primary security contact: Aisha Khan (aisha.khan@brightshore.co), she handles vendor security and evidence exchange. Preferred method: shared Drive link + SFTP for larger artifacts.
